auditor_scope: This auditor checks structural, referential, policy and tag-algebra consistency, and that every semantic question carries a recorded human review. It does NOT establish physical truth: fixture tags are authored by the same hand as the invariants and are not independent evidence. CAD/physics validation is pending for every fixture.
